# Flywheel

> Model-neutral AI gateway, Rowan provider router, Three-Plate and PUCT oracle verification harness with Merkle trace compression, full-track Welch PSD audio and video motion-law deconstructor, local RTX 4090 / Colab RLVR model forge, and offline-verifiable `engine-receipt/1` ledger (`v2.0.0`). Open source under the MIT License (`CC-BY-4.0` for essays and research notes).

- Homepage: https://harperz9.github.io/flywheel.html
- Models & local forge: https://harperz9.github.io/models.html
- Security & agent grants: https://harperz9.github.io/security.html
- PyPI package: https://pypi.org/project/flywheel-verify/
- Repository: https://github.com/HarperZ9/flywheel

## One-Command Install

- PyPI: `python -m pip install flywheel-verify`
- Windows PowerShell (fail-closed `SHA256SUMS`): `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HarperZ9/flywheel/main/install.ps1 | iex`
- Linux / macOS (fail-closed `SHA256SUMS`): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HarperZ9/flywheel/main/install.sh | sh`

## Key Commands

- Run verification gate: `flywheel gate`
- Run Super Solver 6-fault adversarial proof suite: `flywheel super-solver --bench`
- Run PUCT oracle tree search and 34.99x Merkle trace compression proof suite: `flywheel super-solver --search-bench`
- Check model answer values against deciding source: `flywheel check-output`
- Deconstruct audio (4096-pt Hann Welch PSD, spectral tilt, macro DR, <120 Hz phase correlation) and video (frame-to-frame motion-law stats): `gather deconstruct <file>`
- Start writing-lint MCP server: `flywheel-writing-lint-mcp`
- Start writing-workspace MCP server: `flywheel-writing-workspace-mcp`

## Honest Capability Note

The single capability comparison on record scored 9 of 10 for verified inference against 8 of 10 for single-shot (95% difference interval -0.236 to +0.420, includes zero; retired because both arms shared their first attempt). Flywheel provides verifiable provenance, default-deny grants, deterministic execution oracles, and offline receipt checking; it claims no accuracy boost.
